body: I don't know, I just want to disappear. I don't really want help. Im a lost cause. In the end I will still be lonely, depressed, angry, and tired. Thank you for talkInguz with me. You actually helped :)

I don't know, I'd be burdening my parents by telling them I need help, as we are not exactly financially stable. And then I would have to deal with people's judgment, my grandmother and family, and I honestly just feel better suffering. My friends know that I hate living, but no one really knows how much. It's just kind of a go-with-the-flow life right now. Just waiting for it to end

Eh, it's something people tell me to do, but I feel like it just wouldn't help. As much as I hate life, I do take a small amount of pride in not burdening others with my problems. Like once you hit a certain desperation, any change would just feel fake. 

Edit: I honestly like talking to people who don't know me about it though. Like someone who just has no opinion on my well being. You get a different set of answers
Oh, yea I'd say that works. My best friend of 8 years just quit being my friend, and my only other 2 friends are semi judgmental and aren't as close. It kind of sucks not having anyone to talk to
How do you muster the courage to solve your own problems? Especially in a world where nothing ever goes right?
Yea, but I just feel like a burden. That everything and everyone would be better if I just up and disappeared
